snippet.title: PC Building Simulator 2 is coming to Console!
snippet.description:
We're thrilled to announce that PC Building Simulator 2 will be releasing on Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5 on February 26th 2026.

Become the Ultimate PC Builder from the comfort of your living room!
